Each shows a contrast-filled branching vessel tree over a cardiac shadow, with overlay text for patient fields, a processing label, a date and time stamp, small frame labels and projection-angle text. Panels (a) and (b) show a vertical catheter-like dark band at the left; panel (c) does not. No arrows or lesion markers are drawn on any panel.
